6537.title: Plugin lifecycle, history limits, and task pagination
6537.rootCauseOneLine: Thread history silently clamps to 50; plugin source guards require reinstall that clears settings; task cursors enforce a global revision check.
6537.proposedFix: Split the report into scoped work; decide explicit source-transition and pagination contracts without weakening moved-tag security checks.
6537.caveats: Confidence applies to tested paths only. KV survives ordinary removal/reinstall; CLI output supports 32 MiB; fresh worktree teardown passes. Other macOS, visual, historical and third-party claims remain unverified. No safe omnibus simple fix. Tests and evidence are inline in the HTML.
